founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder at awen. Previously served as Head of Operations France at Moda Operandi, a fashion tech scale-up, overseeing creative operations. Prior, worked as an assistant for contemporary artists, supporting artwork production and managing commissions across advertising, cinema, design, fashion, music, and publishing industries. launches.title: Awen
launches.tagline: We translate intent into exceptional visuals through conversation
launches.body:
Bonjour,

AI creative tools became powerful quickly.

But they also got complicated. Most of them require creatives to do the engineering: prompts, parameters, node graphs.

In many cases, creatives are now expected to think like engineers but creative work doesn’t start there. It starts with thinking, exploring directions, and iterating until something feels right. That’s what we wanted to build around.

With **Awen**, we’re trying a different approach:

A creative partner that turns intent into exceptional visuals through conversation.

Watch with sound on and join now on <https://www.awen.ai/>

* If you'd like to connect with us directly, please reach out to [thibault@awen.ai](mailto:thibault@awen.ai).

launches.title: Awen: Imagine Photoshop, but simple?
launches.tagline: awen makes creation as natural as having a conversation.
launches.body:
🎥 **Rather than tell you, we’d rather show you:**

<https://youtu.be/tJ_176h6HiQ>

**TL;DR**

Traditional creative tools are powerful but complex. Awen changes that. Instead of navigating complex menus, creatives can simply describe their vision—_“Draw me a Swiss mountain lake. Now make it sunset. Add a boat. Now animate it.”_

Awen leverages AI reasoning to understand creative intent through voice. Our goal is to redefine how creatives engage with AI technology, balancing power and ease of use for both professionals and newcomers.

We are rebuilding Photoshop, with an AI-voice interface.

**The Team**

Awen is built by Thibault, Pablo, and Antoine—a unique blend of experts in machine learning, software engineering, and creative production in advertising, fashion, media, publishing, and entertainment.

**Shall we speak?**

Our community is growing with talented minds:

* If you'd like to connect with us directly, please reach out to [thibault@awen.ai](mailto:thibault@awen.ai).
* Want to join the visionaries on our waitlist? [Sign-up here.](https://www.awen.ai/)
